checks.name: All entity names exist in the pinned prototypes
Unique entity IDs
Blueprint version is 2.1.25
Only the entities the brief allows: foundry, assembling machine 3, fast, bulk and long-handed inserters, belts and underground belts up to express, pipes, pipes-to-ground, substations, display panels
No combinator, wire other than the substations' copper, robot, chest, pump or tank
Power by substations only, no other pole
No modules, beacons, nonnormal quality, custom inserter reach, tiles or loose items
Every arm has its hand size pinned (fast 1, bulk 2, long-handed 1): research cannot change what it carries
Every arm filter names one item at normal quality
Native collision boxes do not overlap
Published footprint is the selection-box envelope of all entities
Footprint entity counts match
Machines are exactly the manifest list (entity, name, recipe, direction)
Every machine has a fixed recipe saved in the blueprint, one its crafting categories can make, at normal quality
No machine is mirrored or set by circuit
Whole-machine counts: every recipe has the crafting capacity the target needs, recomputed from the pinned recipes, speeds and the foundry's built-in productivity
The sizing table in the manifest is this arithmetic
Exactly the declared recipes are made, nothing else
Fluid model: no unpaired or blocked underground pipe, no mixed network, no pipe run without a machine port, no machine port against another machine
One fluid per pipe network: the networks recomputed from the string are the manifest's
Every port a recipe does not use faces no pipe opening and no other machine's used port
Every used port meets exactly its own fluid, and every fluid box of every machine is on a pipe
No machine has ports on the pipes of two different fluids, and no pump or tank is needed to keep them apart
Every network has exactly one kind of source (an outside entrance or machine outputs) and at least one consumer
Every fluid entrance is a plain pipe on a network of exactly its own fluid, one network per entrance
The manifest lists every pipe with its fluid, every machine box and every unused port as the string has them
Belts: every underground belt has its partner of the same tier within reach, nothing runs into the back of an exit or side-loads an underground
Belt lines recomputed from the string are the manifest's lines, each carrying only its declared items
Every arm takes from and drops on exactly what the manifest says (a machine or a named belt line)
Every arm carries only items its destination takes: nothing foreign can be put on a belt line
Every machine gets every solid ingredient from an arm and has an arm taking its solid products away
Every machine and arm is inside a substation supply area
Substations are wired into one copper network within wire reach
One power connection: the entry substation, labelled by its display panel, with room for an outside substation within wire reach
Substation count is the manifest list
Every entrance and exit entity stands on the footprint edge it names, at the tile the manifest gives
Entrance belts run inward and are not entered from behind; exit belts run outward to the open edge
Every port belt is on the line of its own item, and exits are on lines that carry nothing else
One product exit and one stone exit, each on its own belt line
Every entrance and exit has a display panel beside it with its icon, "IN:" or "OUT:", the item and the per-minute figure
Panel figures are the arithmetic of the target: lava, calcite, plastic and acid rounded up, stone and the product as computed
The approach beyond every entrance and exit is clear of blueprint entities
Blueprint label, description and icons are set
